intake.goal: Absorb the source's communication policy as flexible permanent guidance: clear useful answers, bounded steps where helpful, concrete progress, complete explanations and uncertainty preserved, and no delegation of authorized agent-owned work. Respect the user's demonstrated knowledge and current constraints, including requests for realistic examples or diagrams when they help understanding. Drop diagnostic assumptions, mandatory response templates, redundant source activation/routing and source plugin installation. Preserve all supported communication outcomes without inventing an on-demand capability. Source-native hooks, transport, developer QA and installation instructions were statically inspected and are accounted for in delivery and verification evidence; none are executed or registered.
